messages:
maya: quick sync — spotting a rise in unowned inbound leads from EMEA over the last 3h, looks tied to enrichment timeouts (hubspot -> SF mapping). about 420 leads unassigned. @jon can you take a look? :eyes:
jon: on it. do you have the raw numbers & a suggested mitigation?
maya: gist: 420 unowned, 60 marked VIP by HS but enrichment stalled, most created between 06:00-09:00 UTC. link to sample: https://app.hubspot.com/lead/links/EMEA-spike (internal)
jon: ok — quick mitigation we can roll: 1) reduce enrichment wait from 12s -> 3s 2) enable fallback round-robin to "fallback-owner-pool" for leads that fail enrichment 3) ensure VIP tag bypasses fallback and routes to enterprise-queue. low-risk and reversible.
sasha: low-risk sounds good, but worried about volume routing VIPs incorrectly. how will we detect vip_tag reliably pre-enrichment? some partners set custom property at creation.
emily: idea — workflow order: check `properties.vip_flag == true OR company_size >= 1000` -> route to enterprise-queue; else attempt enrichment with 3s timeout -> if enrichment fails -> fallback RR. That keeps VIPs safe.
jon: here's a quick HS conditional we can add to the workflow (pseudo):
```
if properties.vip_flag == true or properties.company_size >= 1000:
  route_to('enterprise-queue')
else:
  try_enrich(timeout=3s)
  if enrich_success:
    map_to_salesforce()
  else:
    route_to('fallback-owner-pool')
```
jon: I've also prepared a SQL probe to measure unowned leads pre/post: `SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE owner IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND region = 'EMEA';`
maya: rollout plan I'd suggest: 1) create `fallback-owner-pool` and ensure it's paged to SDRs with daily cap 2) add HS workflow change in test HS account 3) flip in prod for EMEA only (4 hour canary) 4) monitor queue depth + SLA from `lead_created -> assigned` (target < 30s median) 5) rollback to previous config if median > 3m or VIP misroutes > 0.5%
jon: can do. I'll patch HS workflow now in staging and run the probe. will also add an alert: `lead.assignment.latency > 180000` (ms) to #marketing-watchdog.
ops-bot: workflow update by jon at 2443219890 — staging workflow created (`enrich-fallback-v1`). :white_check_mark:
sasha: thanks — please schedule a 1-hr post-deploy check at +30m after rollout and leave the probe running for 24h. also capture a sample of misassigned leads (if any).
jon: deployed to prod for EMEA at 2443219915, enabling canary for 4h. monitoring now. will post probe numbers in 30m. :rocket:
maya: awesome — thanks team. if we see >1% VIP misroutes -> rollback immediately.
jon: quick update (2443219930): first 15m metrics: unowned leads down from 420 -> 78, median assign latency 18s, VIP misroutes = 0.02% (1 lead, flagged and re-routed). holding for the full canary window.
